execution._note: PAPER ONLY; a recorded exception to CLAUDE.md rule 3 (team lead, 2026-09-29). Alpaca paper runs no closing auction: staff say it treats cls as a market order at the close with random partial fills (forum, 2026-06-24), and on 2026-09-29 eleven of thirteen cls orders expired unfilled although every NYSE closing auction printed more shares than we asked for. So the plan is DECIDED in the evening (morning backstop) and SENT as market day orders 8 to 2 minutes before the calendar close (15:52-15:58 ET; 12:52-12:58 on a 13:00 early close). Verify scores every fill against the official closing print, in bp. Revisit after a week of fills. REVERT: delete this block (the runner then sends cls exactly as before). Not for a live-money account, where the auction exists and rule 3 stands.
execution._bp_shortfall_note: Team lead 2026-10-07 (plan items 3-5, after the execution-desk review). When a decided plan does not fit Alpaca's order-time buying_power or the overnight Reg T / measured-maintenance limits on the book AFTER the plan, every OPENING order is scaled by one factor (longs and shorts alike) and reductions are sent in full -- instead of refusing the day, which on 2026-10-06 left a stale book after two missed sessions. quantt/session/run.py fit_to_buying_power. REVERT: delete this key (absent = refuse).

data._stale_nav_note: Team lead 2026-10-13 (redesign; report mode first, `on` after a measured week). WHAT: the decide-time stale-NAV gate, quantt/session/nav_gate.py. Yahoo serves a NAV row dated D that carries an older NAV; gate 5 checks only the date (results/cef/LIVE_NAV_QUALITY_2026-10-12.md section 5: 28 of 73 checkable laptop name-days decided on NAV(D-1), 11 orders sized on one). A name whose NAV(D) equals its previous NAV, or CEFConnect's NAV(D-1), is checked against CEFConnect's D: different -> replaced through the logged fallback; equal -> kept; no row or an error -> the decide is deferred to the morning backstop, and from the final check (close - 90 min) the name keeps its current shares, out of the cross-section, never targeted to zero, never the min_names flatten. MODES: absent = off; report = every check and what `on` would do is recorded in plan.json (nav_gate) and <state>/nav_gate.csv, and NOTHING else changes; on = applied. NO-OP PROOF for report: quantt/session/tests/test_nav_gate.py, test_real_sleeve_on_the_real_panel_report_mode_is_byte_identical (live spec, real sleeve, real panel as of 2026-09-25, a held book that trades: same exit, orders, plan_sha and plan.json apart from nav_gate) and test_report_mode_leaves_the_orders_and_the_plan_unchanged (an evening where `on` would defer). CONSEQUENCE accepted: report mode reads CEFConnect once per deployed name at each decide (13 requests); an error there is recorded as UNMEASURED and never stops the session. NOT CHOSEN: `on` now -- the replay (docs/REFERENCES.md section 12s) rests on one week of laptop sessions and on three readings of when CEFConnect publishes D, which the collector now measures. READ BY: quantt/session/run.py stale_nav_for. REVERT: delete this `data` block (the session runs exactly as before the gate). Turning it `on` is another reviewed edit of this key.
